name: Shamir
overview: Shamir is identified in Scripture as both a city in the mountainous region of Judah and a city located on Mount Ephraim. Notably, it served as the home and burial place of Tola, a judge of Israel who led and delivered the people for twenty-three years. Additionally, Shamir is mentioned as a descendant of Michah within the Levitical line, emphasizing its significance in both geographic and genealogical contexts.
